name: Kim Min-jun
headline: 19, former junior developer, stay-at-home father, Seoul
description: Kim Min-jun was a junior developer at a Seoul fintech startup until it collapsed six months ago, and he now spends his days caring for his fourteen-month-old daughter while his wife works at a hospital. He treats job searching like a bidding system, sending applications only to companies whose parental leave and salary bands he has already benchmarked. He also redesigned the family's grocery budget into a spreadsheet and trades baby clothes on a resale app to break even.
